Northern Oil Fields.title: Northern Oil Fields – Legacy Oil Lakes
Northern Oil Fields.headline: Transforming large legacy oil lakes into safe, usable desert land.
Northern Oil Fields.description: During the 1990–1991 conflict, well fires and uncontrolled releases created extensive oil lakes and contaminated soil in the northern fields. Under KERP, these areas are surveyed, excavated, treated and verified to meet strict remediation criteria before being handed back to KOC.
focus: Excavation and segregation of heavily contaminated soil
Thermal desorption, bioremediation and soil washing where applicable
On-site laboratories verifying Total Petroleum Hydrocarbon (TPH) criteria

Southern Oil Fields.title: Southern Oil Fields – Remediation Near Operations
Southern Oil Fields.role: Remediation in and around active production facilities
Southern Oil Fields.headline: Working side‑by‑side with live production to restore the environment safely.
Southern Oil Fields.description: In the south, many contaminated areas are close to active gathering centers, pipelines and wellheads. Remediation here is planned in coordination with ongoing KOC operations to maintain production while progressively cleaning the impacted land.
focus: Interface management with KOC operations and HSE teams
Continuous air, noise and dust monitoring around sensitive receptors

Landfills.title: Engineered Landfills – Long-Term Containment
Landfills.role: Safe containment of non-treatable contaminated materials
Landfills.headline: Engineered cells designed for safe, monitored long-term storage.
Landfills.description: Some highly contaminated materials or debris cannot be economically treated. These streams are placed in engineered landfill cells built to international standards, including multi-layer liners, leachate collection and long-term monitoring.
focus: Construction QA/QC for liner systems and leachate collection
Placement, compaction and capping of wastes
Routine inspection, monitoring and reporting to stakeholders

Water.title: Water Management – Oily Water Treatment
Water.role: Handling and treating oily water generated during remediation
Water.headline: Turning oily water from a waste stream into a managed resource.
Water.description: Excavation and treatment activities can generate oily water from dewatering and washing processes. Dedicated units separate, treat and, where approved, reuse water in line with Kuwaiti environmental regulations and KOC requirements.
focus: Filtration and polishing steps to meet reuse or discharge criteria
Sampling, laboratory testing and regulatory reporting

Laboratories.title: Laboratories & Monitoring – Evidence-Based Decisions
Laboratories.area: On-site field labs and central facilities
Laboratories.role: Verification of soil and water quality
Laboratories.headline: Every handover decision backed by laboratory analysis.
Laboratories.description: KERP relies on extensive sampling to confirm remediation success. Field and central laboratories analyze soil and water samples for hydrocarbons and other parameters, ensuring that treated areas meet agreed criteria before closure.

metrics.label: Samples Analyzed
metrics.value: Tens of thousands of soil samples

focus: Rapid screening tests to support daily field decisions
Full laboratory analysis for compliance and verification
Joint review of results with KOC and independent reviewers
